test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: BNFT is related to FRJX in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JOEA is related to NSIE. To which of the following is HERK related to, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• BNFT is written as FRJX

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cb402fb28577dd63343dd43e75a8fb847c70aac0038ad0c3036208b25404a35.png] 

And,

 
• JOEA is written as NSIE

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c69acb8722d8bec779fae90488b185edc07ec6b434fa44eb8ca901538658f74a.png] 

Similarly,

 
• HERK is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca550ce03e70e0477e5e3b48a23a6a7077045a40582ccc9cf2c186c691a94f64.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**LIVO**".

9d:T
